description: This PHP source file defines the SaveHolidayController class, which extends AbstractVueController and manages the preparation of Vue.js components for holiday editing and saving within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It sets up component properties based on request attributes and provides a list of holiday length options.

classes.name: SaveHolidayController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the save holiday operation, setting up Vue components with appropriate properties based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by setting up whether to use 'holiday-edit' or 'holiday-save' and passing holiday length options.
